title: JobMeta
description:
Main configuration structure for a computation job.
Merges the former JobConfig and NodeMetadata into a single TOML file.

Note: Job dependencies are now defined at the workflow level in WorkflowMetadata,
not in individual job configurations.

inputs.description: List of input file patterns to copy from dependent jobs.

outputs.description: List of output file patterns to collect from the job.

resources.description: Limits and GPU for the job's container (format 1.1).

retry.description: Re-runs of the `run` script after it fails or times out (format 1.1).

timeout.description: Time limit on each attempt of the `run` script (format 1.1).

Container.description:
Represents the container configuration for a job.
The `image` field can be a Docker registry URL or a local file path (.tar or .sif).

image.description:
Docker image source: either a registry URL (e.g., "ubuntu:22.04")
or a local file path (.tar for Docker, .sif for Singularity/Apptainer).

registry.description:
Optional registry hint. Set to `"local"` to bypass default_registry resolution
for images that are built locally and do not exist in any remote registry.

GpuMode.description: Whether a job's container gets the host GPU.

oneOf.description: Passed through when the host has a GPU runtime and the image is built for one.
Always passed through; a host without a GPU runtime refuses the workflow.

Memory.description: A memory limit: a whole number with k, m or g, in binary units.

ParamDefinition.description: Represents a parameter definition in job.toml.

default.description: Any TOML value here; `silva validate` checks it against `type`.

ParamType.description: Represents the type of a parameter.

Resources.description: What a job's container may use (format 1.1). Every field is optional.

cpus.description: CPUs the container may use; may be fractional.

memory.description: Memory limit, with no swap on top.

Scripts.description:
Represents the scripts that will be executed for a job.
All fields are optional and have default values.

Timeout.description: A per-attempt time limit on the `run` script: a whole number with s, m or h.
